t: A free 3-hour high school lesson for making a first population map in QGIS.
steps: Find the Your First Map (QGIS) lesson on the CU Boulder page.
Download the lesson PDF from the Google Drive link.
Ask IT to install QGIS on each computer.
Install QGIS on a test computer first.
Work through the lesson once yourself.
Plan about 3 hours across one or two class periods.
Look for the companion activity on thematic map symbology.
